nodes.label: check_mqtt_no_static_lists

nodes.label: check_name_copies

nodes.label: check_public_text

nodes.label: check_sml_invariants

nodes.label: check_tracked_policy
nodes.desc: Audit that tracked files obey the tracking policy.

nodes.label: py_sizes.csv

nodes.label: habits_baseline.json
nodes.desc: Per-file counts of five code habits (lost tracebacks, dated owner notes, source-text tests, exits on import, exec-loaded parts) that may only go down; check_habits.py --update lowers them and refuses a rise.

nodes.label: mypy_baseline.json
nodes.desc: mypy's error count per CPython file outside hartlib, which may only go down; check_mypy.py --update lowers it and refuses a rise.

nodes.label: check_wiring_crosswalk
nodes.desc: Audit: each physical mast head matches wiring.csv; staging and main/upper heads match mast csvs and tables.xml.

nodes.label: helix fixture scripts

nodes.label: main level benchwork scripts

nodes.label: check_stl.py
nodes.desc: Validates the exported station map STLs.

nodes.label: tools/check.sh

nodes.label: films.py {ctc,cats,le}
nodes.desc: Builds the stop-motion films of the CTC, CATS and Layout Editor panels from dated screenshots (film_ctc.py, film_cats.py, film_le.py).

nodes.label: build_docs_index.py
nodes.desc: Lists docs/ documents (tracked or new) newest first into docs/INDEX.md; --check in tools/check.sh.

nodes.label: status_counts.py
nodes.desc: Builds wiki/STATUS.md from the entry files in wiki/status/ and the Counts line from tables.xml masts/SML and dispatcher traininfo (make status, ADR-038); --check fails an entry over 60 words and builds the page in memory.

nodes.label: diverging_vo.json
nodes.desc: Voiceover script lines for the Diverging Route promo, keyed per line.

nodes.label: soundtrack.py
nodes.desc: Generates the promo music bed.

nodes.label: promo_shots.py
nodes.desc: The promo cuts' tables: site pages captured, build-cut photos and site-cut page regions in capture pixels.

nodes.label: tiktok_promo.py
nodes.desc: Builds promo videos: screenshots site pages (behind, ai) into shots, mixes vo and music, writes mp4 and srt.

nodes.label: voiceover.py
nodes.desc: F5-TTS (MLX) speaks the promo lines, one WAV per line; runs in its own venv.

nodes.label: evolution.py
nodes.desc: Renders every committed version of the published schematic SVG from git history into frames (media/schematic-evolution) and an animated GIF; --site also writes the site film and poster into www/assets/behind/panel-evolution and the version count and dates on behind/panel-evolution.html; --check compares them with history.

nodes.label: wiki/STATUS.md
nodes.desc: Project status page, built from the entry files in wiki/status/ by make status and the session-start hook, with the Counts line computed at build time; gitignored (ADR-038).

nodes.label: rewrite_button_icon_paths.py

Ships tables.xml, CATS desks, jython, host scripts.

nodes.label: Windows host scripts
nodes.desc: Windows batch and PowerShell launchers for CATS and apply package, patch MQTT.

nodes.label: hart_trains.csv
nodes.desc: The CATS train list as a flat CSV (name, symbol, engine, font, runs_job, notes), written from the on_desks rows of trains.csv by build_hart_trains.py; never edited by hand.

nodes.label: generated_desk_header.xml
nodes.desc: Fonts, templates, train, job and crew stores and the publication plate of the CATS desks, frozen from the hand-wired desk; its train list must match trains.csv (check_train_symbols.py).

nodes.label: HART_ABS.xml
nodes.desc: ABS twin of the CTC desk; installed on hosts.

nodes.label: HART_CTC.bindings.json
nodes.desc: Bindings of desk blocks, switches and masts to live JMRI objects, written from the railroad facts.

nodes.label: HART_CTC.xml
nodes.desc: HART_CTC.xml and HART_ABS.xml CATS desk panels shipped to hosts; checked by layout-facts, the panels check (cats --check, approved-desks) and the CATS tests.

nodes.label: cats_inspect.py {edges,grid,trace}
nodes.desc: Read-only inspectors of a CATS panel: SEC_EDGE joint types, the cell grid, and where each plant's legs lead (digicon_trace.py).

nodes.label: render_cats_panel.py
nodes.desc: Renders the Digicon panel image used with CATS hotspot index.

nodes.label: speedmatch site_labels + logs
nodes.desc: Speed-match logs (~/speedmatch-logs) and site_labels.json labels fed to export_site_runs.

nodes.label: schematic-system-draft.pdf
nodes.desc: Letter landscape PDF of the system schematic.

nodes.label: schematic-system-draft.svg
nodes.desc: Published system schematic of all levels; checked in by publish_draft.

nodes.label: docs/ops/stations/*.svg
nodes.desc: Per-area station map SVGs (barn, east-end, princess, main-level) published by tools/schematic/publish_draft.py (schematic domain).

nodes.label: AnyRail plan 5.3c (.any)
nodes.desc: Owner's private binary AnyRail plan in ~/Documents/Layout, never committed; the source of track geometry for every level.

nodes.label: hartlib (shared library)
nodes.desc: Shared Python library (paths, level_devices, parked, map_revision) imported by the www build scripts.

nodes.label: Ops Pro showcase GUIDE.md
nodes.desc: Master walkthrough in the model-railroad-skills submodule; copied byte for byte into the site.

nodes.label: schematic-maps plugin
nodes.desc: Submodule plugin that reads the AnyRail .any plan (schematic anyplan: parts list, helix cut stubs), solves and draws the schematic and builds CATS desks (cats module) and LE panels; cache in ~/.cache/hart/schematic.

nodes.label: Owner AnyRail edits
nodes.desc: Owner draws the layout plan (version 5.3c) in AnyRail; the source of track geometry for all levels.

nodes.label: Owner/agent data edits
nodes.desc: Hand edits of the layer CSV/JSON files, plan_overrides.json and the owner's cells in devices_field.csv that author the layout facts.

nodes.label: Owner PanelPro session / Store
nodes.desc: Owner edits the layout in PanelPro on Pi or Mac and presses Store, rewriting host tables.xml.

nodes.label: anyrail/hart.xml
nodes.desc: AnyRail JMRI export snapshot; geometry source for the original bootstrap, kept for reference.

nodes.label: USS CTC icons and GUIObjects.xml
nodes.desc: USS CTC machine GUI objects and icons; not shipped while uss is parked.

nodes.label: block_lengths.csv
nodes.desc: Each JMRI block's length in the AnyRail plan 5.3c, by level and block id (no names): written only by plan_lengths.py; hartlib.block_lengths gives the plan length and, with block_lengths_measured.csv, the operating length.

nodes.label: block_lengths_measured.csv
nodes.desc: The block lengths speed matching measured (id, measured_in, run, date), written only by infer_block_lengths.py --apply; over block_lengths.csv as the operating length (tables.xml, speed matching).

nodes.label: devices.columns.csv
nodes.desc: Column dictionary for the device master (both files), read by hartlib.devices; a test holds the two to each other.

nodes.label: mast_cells.csv
nodes.desc: Per mast: cell on the USS CTC board grid and icon; kept for unparking.

nodes.label: approved_cats_abs.sha256
nodes.desc: Approved fingerprint of the CATS ABS desk HART_ABS.xml.

nodes.label: approved_cats_ctc.sha256
nodes.desc: Approved fingerprint of the CATS CTC desk HART_CTC.xml.

nodes.label: approved_le_panel.sha256
nodes.desc: Owner-approved fingerprint of the live three-level HART Railroad panel in tables.xml.

nodes.label: block_overrides.csv
nodes.desc: The owner's hand facts about blocks, by kind: split (tracks parted into two blocks at their turnback, the owner's choice), track (pieces of track inside an OS block, their lengths) and crossover_half.

nodes.label: block_numbering.csv
nodes.desc: The main and upper blocks' JMRI numbers (IB:C3:<n>, ILB<1000+n>), by device ID: a renamed block's sort place, appended and retired blocks. Read by hartlib.block_numbering; build_device_map.py copies the numbers into the block rows.

nodes.label: discovered_sml.xml
nodes.desc: Signal Mast Logic and mast properties captured from stock JMRI discovery; merged into tables.xml.

nodes.label: inputs/main.json
nodes.desc: Plan graph of main and upper levels (nodes, edges, hand, cm); track only, from AnyRail.

nodes.label: inputs/parts.json
nodes.desc: Track parts list (T numbers, end points) from the AnyRail plan; read by the schematic plugin and plan_lengths.

nodes.label: inputs/staging.json
nodes.desc: Plan graph of the staging level, from AnyRail.

nodes.label: interlockings.csv
nodes.desc: Interlocking control points for every level, keyed by cp_id (cp:107); the signal rule's control points. The cp cells of the device pair and masts.csv name them by id (hartlib.places).

nodes.label: main_lines.csv
nodes.desc: Main line routes (main_upper and staging rows) for milepost and main route flags.

nodes.label: masts.csv
nodes.desc: Every level's masts, a level column (owner 2026-11-21), with staging's plan facts; written by build_masts.py in make panels.

nodes.label: panel_items.json
nodes.desc: Layout Editor panel's own icons, labels, status cluster, frame captions, backdrop; attributes tied to staging track.

nodes.label: plan_overrides.json
nodes.desc: The owner's hand edits to the plan graph (relabel, names, control_points, stations, main_route) and the helix ends; generated keys are in plan_generated.json (T6b).

nodes.label: preferences.json
nodes.desc: Schematic drawing preferences per level, detail_sheets (staging generated), host_screen (the LE and CATS windows), le_stretch. Tracks are named by block ID (min_cells, turnbacks, track_labels, the label options); hartlib.layer_files.merged gives them their names from the name store.

nodes.label: retired_virtual_masts.csv
nodes.desc: Virtual masts retired from staging; kept so names are not reused.

nodes.label: sheets.csv
nodes.desc: Station detail sheets of every level and the stations each draws.

nodes.label: signals.json
nodes.desc: Layer 1 masts per sheet (staging, main_upper) from plan graph and masts; the schematic solve reads it.

nodes.label: stations.csv
nodes.desc: Stations of every level, keyed by station_id (st:barn), and their desk areas; the cp cells of the device pair and masts.csv name them by id (hartlib.places). Used to place OS blocks into control points in layout index. Its tracks cell gives block IDs, named by the name store (hartlib.railroad_facts.station_tracks).

nodes.label: store_splits.csv
nodes.desc: Records which Store hashes were split in; lets the next deploy replace the host file.

nodes.label: switches.csv
nodes.desc: Every level's switches, one row per OS block or switch half: legs, hand (plan or owner), local area; staging's Layout Editor turnout, CATS inversion, USS lever. Read by CATS, LE, device map and facts checks.

nodes.label: tables_template.xml
nodes.desc: What PanelPro owns in tables.xml: settings, memories, clock sensor, hide-windows LogixNG. Updated by split_store.py from kept Store changes, or one line at a time by template_edit.py.

nodes.label: uss_board_cells.csv / uss_board_plants.csv
nodes.desc: USS CTC board grid cells and switch plant cells frozen from the hand-wired desk.

nodes.label: dispatcher (options, traininfo, guide)
nodes.desc: JMRI Dispatcher System options and traininfo files plus guide PDF; not shipped while dispatcher is parked.

nodes.label: tables.xml
nodes.desc: The one generated JMRI tables file: turnouts, sensors, blocks, masts, heads, SML, three-level HART Railroad Layout Editor panel. Shipped to all hosts.

nodes.label: hart/parked scripts
nodes.desc: apply_nx_layer, occupancy lamps, retarget traininfo, staging_panel_lamps.json; parked feature tools.

nodes.label: tables_parked.xml
nodes.desc: Frozen snapshot of parked Entry/Exit, Dispatcher System and USS CTC elements split out of tables.xml.

nodes.label: audit_panel_contracts.py
nodes.desc: Audits tables.xml panel contracts; also run at deploy.

nodes.label: disable_digicon_sml_in_tables.py
nodes.desc: Deploy gate: --check that Digicon masts' logic is stored disabled in tables.xml.

nodes.label: discover_nx.py / generate_nx_pairs.py
nodes.desc: Entry/Exit (NX) discovery and pair generation; parked.

nodes.label: discover_sml.py
nodes.desc: Jython run in PanelPro: stock SML discovery on the layout; stores the result.

nodes.label: export_track_lengths.py
nodes.desc: Track length export (check: track-lengths) reading levels data.

nodes.label: TRACK_LENGTHS.md
nodes.desc: Generated table of every block's length, from block_lengths.csv and tables.xml; export_track_lengths.py --check fails while it is stale.

nodes.label: gen_ctc_track_plan.py
nodes.desc: Generates the USS CTC track plan from mast_cells and uss_board data; USS CTC and build_ctc_full_15col.py parked.

nodes.label: hide_cats_desk_windows.py
nodes.desc: Jython shipped to JMRI: hides CATS desk windows on start.

nodes.label: hide_band_panels.py
nodes.desc: Jython shipped to JMRI: hides the Staging Level, Main Level and Upper Level panels once they open.

nodes.label: jmri_cmd_watcher.py
nodes.desc: Jython shipped to JMRI: command watcher.

nodes.label: panel_status.py
nodes.desc: Jython shipped to JMRI: status lamps and click handling for turnouts, signals, LCOS and track power icons.

nodes.label: panel_status_turnouts.py
nodes.desc: Jython module of panel_status.py: the Turnouts lamp (which plants it counts, its colour, the click that flips TWOSENSOR and DIRECT).

nodes.label: panel_status_clicks.py
nodes.desc: Jython module of panel_status.py: the status lamp clicks at any zoom and the lift of buried block labels.

nodes.label: render_le_layout.py
nodes.desc: Renders the Layout Editor schematic PNG; its geometry/transform is reused by build_layout_index for hotspot alignment.

nodes.label: run_dispatcher_stage1.py
nodes.desc: Dispatcher System Stage 1 runner and traininfo repair/ensure scripts; parked with the Dispatcher System.

nodes.label: run_sml_discover.sh
nodes.desc: Writes discovery-base tables, launches PanelPro with discover_sml.py, captures Signal Mast Logic into discovered_sml.xml and its discovered_sml.stamp; run by hand when masts change.

nodes.label: export_site_runs.py
nodes.desc: Exports recorded speed-match runs and replay frames as static JSON for the website, with labels.

nodes.label: anyrail/levels (svg, meta)
nodes.desc: staging.svg, main.svg, upper.svg and levels_meta.json (plan, levels, helix, ramps, grade) committed in the repo.

nodes.label: levels_page.py
nodes.desc: Renders the Build track-plan article from level SVGs, block_lengths, the helix tracks (plan_overrides, track_labels) and speedmatch routes; --check in tools/check.sh.

nodes.label: levels_svg.py / levels_page.py
nodes.desc: Reads the .any plan and writes per-level SVGs and levels_meta.json; --check by tools/check.sh; skipped where plan is absent.

nodes.label: anyrail prototype (archived)
nodes.desc: Early graph and route parsing prototypes (parse1/2, hartgraph, loop_route); superseded by the schematic-maps plugin's anyplan reader. Archived 2026-11-23; nothing calls it.

nodes.label: hartlib devices.py (and railroad*, wiring, layer_files)
nodes.desc: Library that loads the device master (devices_generated.csv merged with devices_field.csv) and the layer files, enforces invariants; CLI python3 -m hartlib.devices check validates the master and public names.

nodes.label: hartlib map_revision.py
nodes.desc: Computes and checks the map revision and date across the schematic, station sheets and www data; rebuilds www/data/crew.json through crew_master.build.

nodes.label: hartlib parked.py
nodes.desc: Defines the parked features (nx, dispatcher, uss); lists folders and jython the deploy skips; checks tables.xml against tables_parked.xml.

nodes.label: hartlib store_split.py
nodes.desc: Library for the split: classifies items kept, clash, device, dropped; verifies the rebuild.

nodes.label: hartlib tables_build.py
nodes.desc: Library used by build_tables: fixed envelope, every level's beans from the device master (devices_generated.csv and devices_field.csv) and the startup LogixNG from its start column, block lengths, comments from wiring or bean_comment, SML merge.

nodes.label: pull_tables.sh
nodes.desc: make tables-pull: same for a Store on the Mac, saved as mac-<date>.xml. --status (make orient) only says whether one is waiting.

nodes.label: pull_tables_pi.sh
nodes.desc: make tables-pull-pi (also run by the deploy gate): copies a changed Pi Store to media/pulled-stores/pi-<date>.xml with a .base file.

nodes.label: rebuild_publications.sh (make publications)
nodes.desc: Creates hart-ops venv and runs each rebuild_*.py and update_tt23_station_map.py to write docs/ops.

nodes.label: approval.py / check_approved.py
nodes.desc: Fingerprints panel elements; check_approved runs in make panels (desks, live panel) and stops drift from owner-approved hashes.

nodes.label: build_cats_panel.py
nodes.desc: make panels/make desks step: generates CATS CTC and ABS desks and bindings via the plugin's cats module from switches, devices, tables and signals.

nodes.label: build_device_map.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 7, with its modules device_map_inputs.py (the readers), device_map_schematic.py (the drawing's tracks), device_map_rows.py (every level's row makers and the owner's values over them), device_map_staging.py (staging's rows) and device_map_masts.py (staging's masts, build_masts.py part 1 until naming-layers step 12): writes every level's turnout, feedback, block, occupancy, mast and head rows to devices_generated.csv, each generated from the plan with the owner's cells from devices_field.csv over it (naming-layers step 7), and (T6b) the plan_generated.json main_upper section from the solved sheet.

nodes.label: build_hands.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 1 (hands): writes the hand of switches.csv's plan rows from the plan graph and relabel edits; owner hands are left alone. Staging rows give device ids only, which the read checks against the name store.

nodes.label: build_layout_le.py
nodes.desc: Library build_tables calls in memory: the three-level Layout Editor panel from the device master (devices_generated.csv and devices_field.csv) and the schematic, on the base's beans (it adds none); writes no file of its own.

nodes.label: build_main_route.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 3: writes main_route, staging milepost_route and name_main (the runs of the staging main lines, which the name store flags main in the plugin's name edit) into plan_generated.json from main_lines.csv.

nodes.label: build_masts.py
nodes.desc: make panels masts step: masts.csv for every level from the device master's mast and head rows (build_device_map.py writes them since naming-layers step 12), with staging's plan facts from the same plan (device_map_masts.staging_masts).

nodes.label: build_signals.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 6: writes signals.json from the plan graph and the mast CSVs.

nodes.label: build_staging_sets.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 2: writes staging control points and stations into plan_generated.json and detail sheets into preferences_generated.json.

nodes.label: band_panels.py
nodes.desc: Library build_tables calls after the Layout Editor build: the Staging Level, Main Level and Upper Level panels, copies of the HART Railroad panel trimmed to one band each, joined by edge connectors.

nodes.label: build_tables.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 12: writes tables.xml from the template, the device master's beans, the LE build and discovered SML; applies Digicon boot rule.

nodes.label: check_device_master.py
nodes.desc: Check only in make panels: device master rules (both files), rows against tables.xml and schematic.

nodes.label: plan_lengths.py
nodes.desc: Writes block_lengths.csv (level, id, plan_in) from the AnyRail plan, run by hand; make panels only checks it. The measured lengths sit beside it in block_lengths_measured.csv (infer_block_lengths.py).

nodes.label: publish_draft.py
nodes.desc: make panels step 9: draws the system schematic and station sheets with the plugin, prints PDF via Chrome, updates map revision data.

nodes.label: split_store.py
nodes.desc: Splits a pulled Store back into sources: kept items to tables_template.xml, merged devices_field.csv cells (a Store's new device is added there), records store_splits.csv, rebuilds tables.xml.

nodes.label: sync_signals.py
nodes.desc: Check only in make panels: every level's heads and masts in tables.xml follow masts.csv.

nodes.label: www site pages
nodes.desc: Website pages (behind/wiring, ai/*) that promo screenshots capture.

nodes.label: docs/ops publications
nodes.desc: Crew, dispatcher, yardmaster, station map, primer DOCX, TT-23 pptx, Operator Sheet and Publication Standards. Linked from the website.

nodes.label: jmri-cs105-roster-sync
nodes.desc: Public submodule holding cs105_roster_sync.py, the generic roster to CS-105 script.

nodes.label: sts-docker (STS app)
nodes.desc: Submodule: Shipper-driven Traffic Simulator PHP/MySQL docker stack. A Mac copy for UAT and a sandbox copy.

nodes.label: sts-docker-data
nodes.desc: STS data volume: database, backups, Rolling Stock photos, config, images, pi/ copies of live backups and dumps.

nodes.label: STS Rolling Stock photos
nodes.desc: {car id}.jpg photos served by STS; written by add_hart_cars, tracked in hart repo.

nodes.label: STS backups

nodes.label: node_grid_svg.py

nodes.label: redeploy_commit.sh

nodes.label: live_paths.py

nodes.label: install_ops_files.sh
nodes.desc: Installs the six Operations Pro files into a host's JMRI operations folder, keeping a backup; guards an unpulled session.

nodes.label: install_jmri_web_override.sh

nodes.label: JMRI web home (Home.html)
nodes.desc: Hand-written JMRI web server home page with the STS and mimic links; hosts get it from the deploy.

nodes.label: patch_jmri_startup.py
nodes.desc: Adds or removes a Start Up script entry in a JMRI profile, used by the deploy to register the shipped jython.

nodes.label: agent_docs_map.py
nodes.desc: Draws the agent-doc lane of this map from the files: a box per agent doc and the links between them, in reading order from AGENTS.md; build_pipeline_map.py runs it and its --check fails when the graph differs.

nodes.label: map_lane.py
nodes.desc: The map's manifest lane: a box for each check.sh step's script, its inputs and outputs and its link to check.sh, from the step manifest (gen: manifest); build_pipeline_map.py draws it after the agent-doc lane.

nodes.label: build_pipeline_map.py
nodes.desc: Checks pipeline_map.json is current and that both map pages build; --check writes nothing. The pages are built, not committed (ADR-036): make map locally, the site build for the website.

nodes.label: merge_pipeline_map.py
nodes.desc: git merge driver for pipeline_map.json (by node id and edge ends); set by make wt and the session-start hook.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_page.html
nodes.desc: Page template for both pipeline map pages: the toolbar, panels and styles around the map.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_layout.js
nodes.desc: Layout script (pure functions) inlined into both pipeline map pages; the unit tests run it under node.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_helpers.js
nodes.desc: The layout's helpers (pure functions: lane tags, picking, chains, fitting, folding), inlined after it; node loads them through the layout.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_view.js
nodes.desc: Viewer script (the page's state, drawing and input) inlined into both pipeline map pages after the layout: the start of app(), which goes on in pipeline_map_view_frame.js and pipeline_map_view_input.js, joined in that order.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_view_frame.js
nodes.desc: The middle of the viewer's app() (overview, headers, dark mode, lane zoom, pan and zoom), inlined straight after pipeline_map_view.js; not a script on its own.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_view_input.js
nodes.desc: The end of the viewer's app() (magnifier, selection, search, filters, menus, tour, share, address), inlined straight after pipeline_map_view_frame.js; it closes app() and calls it.

nodes.label: pipeline_map.json
nodes.desc: This map: domains, nodes and edges of every source, generator and output; hand-kept, checked against the repo.

nodes.label: docs/pipeline-map/index.html
nodes.desc: The repo copy of the pipeline map page; not committed (ADR-036): make map builds it, check.sh and CI build it in memory (--check).

nodes.label: library/pipeline-map.html
nodes.desc: Local copy of the website's pipeline map, for the site preview; not committed (ADR-036): make map builds it, and the website build writes its own copy (site_page()).

nodes.label: pipeline_query.py
nodes.desc: Prints what writes or reads a file, from pipeline_map.json, for agents and people.

nodes.label: pipeline_map_coverage.py
nodes.desc: check.sh pipeline-map-coverage: fails when a script the Makefile, make panels or a deploy runs, or a file in an output folder or an agent doc, is not in pipeline_map.json (check.sh's checks are boxes by construction: the manifest lane).

nodes.label: checks.toml
nodes.desc: The step manifest (ADR-037): one [[step]] per check.sh read-only check, with its command, lane and the files it reads and writes. check.sh and docs_checks.sh run their checks from it (ADR-037).

nodes.label: panels.toml
nodes.desc: The panels manifest (ADR-037 stage 5): one [[step]] per make panels step or guard, in run order, with its command, check_args, outputs (the stamps') and the files it reads; build_panels.sh runs them, panel_stamps.py takes the outputs, and the map draws each step's box from it.

nodes.label: manifest.py
nodes.desc: Loads and checks the step manifest against git and the map (names, commands, paths, lanes); prints each runner's job lines (jobs) and the steps (list); check.sh and docs_checks.sh run those lines, and the job stamps key on each job's entry and git refs (job_keys); every step is a job of its own.

nodes.label: speedmatch scripts
nodes.desc: Speed-match analysis (analyze.py, liverule.py), the Mac dashboard and the Pi live publisher (dashboard/publish_live.py with dashstate, dashsources); the deploy stages the publisher and its page for the Pi.

nodes.label: devices_generated.csv
nodes.desc: Device master, all three levels, the builders' file: every turnout, sensor, block, head, mast with public name, JMRI/system names, wiring, DCC address. Written only by build_device_map and panel_items; hartlib.devices merges it with devices_field.csv into the one view readers get.

nodes.label: devices_field.csv
nodes.desc: The device master's owner's cells, keyed by level and device id: staging's devices (names, layout blocks, comments, DCC, control points) and a Store's level-less devices. Written by hand and by split_store.py; read by the builders.

nodes.label: media/schematic-evolution

nodes.label: media/pulled-stores

nodes.label: panel-evolution films
nodes.desc: The four panel films and posters (schematic, CATS, LE, USS) shown on behind/panel-evolution.html; the schematic pair is written by evolution.py --site.

nodes.label: template_edit.py

nodes.label: <main checkout>/.cache/hart/schematic

nodes.label: <main checkout>/.cache/hart/check-stamps
nodes.desc: tools/check.sh job stamps (check_stamps.py): content hashes of a job's declared inputs; a job whose inputs match its last pass is skipped (not in CI, not with FULL=1) (#880). On the Windows box each ref of make remote has its own copy (check-stamps-by-ref/, win_run.sh).

nodes.label: discovered_sml.stamp
nodes.desc: Digest of the discovery base that run_sml_discover.sh used; the sml-current guard compares it with the base the sources give now.

nodes.label: plan_generated.json
nodes.desc: The generated half of plan_overrides: staging control points and stations, name_main and milepost_route, main_upper main_route, control_points and stations. Each of three builders replaces only its own keys (T6b).

nodes.label: preferences_generated.json
nodes.desc: The generated half of preferences: staging's detail_sheets, from sheets.csv. hartlib.layer_files merges it under preferences.json (hand values win).

nodes.label: panel_window_sizes.py
nodes.desc: Sets each Layout Editor panel window size a JMRI profile remembers (user-interface.xml) to the size tables.xml gives it; run by hand with JMRI closed, not part of make panels or a deploy.

nodes.label: pi_panel_window_sizes.sh
nodes.desc: Runs panel_window_sizes.py on the Pi's profile: checks first, quits PanelPro, sets the sizes, keeps a backup and starts PanelPro again.

nodes.label: pi-os image build
nodes.desc: Builds the layout Pi's 64-bit trixie SD card image on the Mac (sdm pluglist, Lima VM); the image holds secrets and never leaves the Mac.

nodes.label: operating.sh

nodes.label: move_path.py
nodes.desc: Moves or renames a tracked file or folder (git mv) and rewrites every repo-root path, relative link and a moved script's repo-root depth that names it; lists name-only mentions to check by hand; rebuilds the docs index and map pages.

nodes.label: hart-mqtt-race-fix.jar

nodes.label: install_overlay.py

nodes.label: hartlib hand_lists.py
nodes.desc: The one reader of the owner's hand lists: block_overrides.csv, main_lines.csv (stops by block ID, named from the name store), mast_cells.csv and the USS board grid; each stops naming the file and line.

nodes.label: hartlib drawing_keys.py
nodes.desc: The one reader of the device master's drawing keys (trial_name) for every level: each schematic piece's device by ID, named from the merged view (naming-layers step 13).

nodes.label: check_data_readers
nodes.desc: Audit: no script outside hartlib names a layout data file (jmri/layouts/hart/data/) but the pairs it allows, each with its reason; Jython inside JMRI reads only generated outputs.

nodes.label: check_wiring_frozen.py
nodes.desc: Audits wiring.csv against the form the wiring freeze left it in; writes nothing.

nodes.label: hartlib railroad.py
nodes.desc: The fact files against each other (the device master, switches.csv, masts.csv, the tables file); KNOWN in hartlib.railroad lists what is reported and left.

nodes.label: check_data.py
nodes.desc: Checks every master CSV against its <name>.columns.csv sidecar: types, enum values, required cells, unique keys and references into other masters (ADR-039).

nodes.label: check_json.py
nodes.desc: Checks plan_overrides.json, preferences.json, panel_items.json and published-files.json against a schema each: the keys, types and values their readers depend on (ADR-039).

nodes.label: build_hart_trains.py
nodes.desc: Writes the CATS train list cats/data/hart_trains.csv from the train master trains.csv, in the CATS file's own columns (ADR-039); --check.

nodes.label: check_train_symbols.py
nodes.desc: Checks that the crew master's crew job codes, the Operations Pro train names and the CATS desks' train list name trains of trains.csv (ADR-039).

nodes.label: check_locos.py
nodes.desc: Checks that every engine in both Operations Pro engine rosters and every engine in the train list is a row of the loco master locos.csv, keyed on roster_id (ADR-039).

nodes.label: check_roster.py
nodes.desc: Checks the DecoderPro roster master (roster.xml and the entry files it names) and that each roster loco is a locos.csv row with the roster's DCC address (ADR-039).

nodes.label: check_fleet_gallery.py
nodes.desc: Checks the public rolling-stock gallery fleet-gallery.json against the car master image_metadata.csv and the loco master locos.csv: each item is a master row with its number and type, album counts match, and every photographed row is shown (ADR-039).

nodes.label: archive_catalogue.py
nodes.desc: Checks archive.json and the lineage charts against the archive catalogue archive_catalogue.csv: each archive item's file and credit are its row's, and each lineage logo cites a catalogue id (ADR-039); --write sets the logos from their ids.

nodes.label: crew_master.py
nodes.desc: The crew master's views; build() is the one writer of www/data/crew.json, called by build_crew_json.py and hartlib.map_revision.

nodes.label: build_crew_json.py
nodes.desc: Writes www/data/crew.json from the crew master ops/hart-ops/data/crew.json after its schema check, with the spot sheet's industry names from industries.csv and the schematic's revision from the title block (ADR-039); --check.

nodes.label: check_py_sizes
nodes.desc: Fails when a .py or .js file over 800 lines, or a .sh file over 500, grows past its row in tools/audit/py_sizes.csv; warns at 90 percent of the limit; a shrink passes with a note; --update tightens the list, --accept raises a row by name.

nodes.label: check_habits
nodes.desc: Fails when a tracked .py file's count of a code habit (lost traceback, dated owner note, source-text test, exit on import, exec-loaded part) rises above tools/audit/habits_baseline.json; a fall passes with a note; --update lowers it and refuses any rise.

nodes.label: check_mypy
nodes.desc: mypy (mypy.ini) over the CPython files: hartlib with no errors, every other file at or below its error count in tools/audit/mypy_baseline.json (below passes with a note); --update lowers the baseline and refuses a rise.

nodes.label: backup_launchagents.sh (make backup-status)
nodes.desc: Installs and checks the Mac LaunchAgents that run the daily Pi pull and the weekly Windows push (ADR-035).

nodes.label: backup_pi_pull.sh

nodes.label: backup_win_push.sh
nodes.desc: Weekly: mirrors the Mac's gitignored data, the Pi snapshots and the AnyRail plans into WSL on the Windows box (ADR-035).

nodes.label: site_views.py
nodes.desc: The files the site publishes that are built, not committed (ADR-036): the pipeline map page and the generated JSON, each with the builder that returns its checked text. The site build writes them into the build; make site-data and serve_portal.py write them into www/ for the local preview, removing one that cannot be built.

nodes.label: common.sh

nodes.label: stage.sh

nodes.label: ship_mac.sh
nodes.desc: Deploy step 3: installs on this Mac (~/JMRI_UserFiles): tables.xml, Operations files, CATS panels, CTC icons, Jython and Start Up, web override, MQTT overlay, deploy stamp.

nodes.label: ship_pi.sh
nodes.desc: Deploy step 4: rsyncs the staged Pi package to the Pi's drop folder and runs apply_hart_package_local.sh there, then starts PanelPro again if it was quit for the deploy.

nodes.label: ship_win.sh
nodes.desc: Deploy step 5: sends the staged Windows package as one tarball (scp) and runs apply_hart_package_local.ps1 there.

nodes.label: ci_pass.py
nodes.desc: Says whether CI's full check.sh pass covers the commit a deploy ships, so the gate may skip build_tables --check; reads the GitHub run log.

nodes.label: apply_hart_package_local.sh
nodes.desc: Runs on the Pi: installs the deploy drop into JMRI_UserFiles and the ~/.jmri profiles (tables.xml, panels, Jython, resources, Operations, overlay, Start Up, speed-match publisher and its unit, desktop icons).

nodes.label: panelpro_profile.py
nodes.desc: The JMRI profile steps of a Mac PanelPro run: checks the profile, turns off Start Up items that run code, backs up, seals and restores profile.xml.

nodes.label: le_tables.py
nodes.desc: Module of build_layout_le.py: puts the Layout Editor panel into the tables, retires the yard ladder, checks every bound name is a base bean and the block numbers match block_numbering.csv.

nodes.label: load_env.sh
nodes.desc: Sourced by the shell tools: repo paths and host settings from the environment, tools/env/hart.env and defaults.

nodes.label: profile_tables_guard.sh
nodes.desc: Guards sourced by the deploy, launch_cats.sh and the PanelPro wrappers: the unpulled-Store test, the HART_TABLES refusal and the unrestored-profile refusal.

nodes.label: deploy_status.sh

nodes.label: pi_quit_panelpro.sh

nodes.label: pi_start_panelpro.sh

nodes.label: panelpro_session.sh
nodes.desc: One PanelPro run on this Mac, sourced by the run_*.sh wrappers: profile backup and restore, Start Up items that run code off, the tables to load, stopping PanelPro on timeout.

nodes.label: run_panelpro_roundtrip.sh

nodes.label: win_run.sh

nodes.label: panel_snapshot.sh

nodes.label: sandbox_env.sh
nodes.desc: Environment for a sandbox PanelPro run: a copy of the live profile with its own user files and a local MQTT broker.

nodes.label: hart-speedmatch-live.service
nodes.desc: Pi systemd user unit running dashboard/publish_live.py from ~/speedmatch/publisher; installed by apply_hart_package_local.sh.

nodes.label: install_desktop_icons.sh
nodes.desc: Runs on the Pi: installs the CATS CTC and CATS ABS desktop icons from the drop, removes old ones.

nodes.label: launch_cats.sh
nodes.desc: Pi CATS launcher installed to JMRI_UserFiles/cats/launch: starts CATS with a HART desk panel on the PanelPro profile.

nodes.label: launch_cats_ctc_desktop.sh
nodes.desc: Pi desktop icon target: launch_cats.sh with HART_CTC.xml.

nodes.label: launch_cats_abs_desktop.sh
nodes.desc: Pi desktop icon target: launch_cats.sh with HART_ABS.xml.

nodes.label: launch_trainstat.sh
nodes.desc: Launches TrainStat (yard client) against CATS on the Pi with hart_trainstat.xml.

nodes.label: launch_trainstat_desktop.sh
nodes.desc: Pi desktop icon target: runs launch_trainstat.sh in the background and logs.

nodes.label: panelpro_restart_due.sh
nodes.desc: Runs on the Pi after a deploy: says whether PanelPro was quit for the deploy and should start again.

nodes.label: tables_base.sh
nodes.desc: Runs on the host a Store is pulled from: names the tables.xml before the owner's session (deploy stamp or last pull), the base split_store.py compares with.

nodes.label: unpulled_changes.sh
